observedProductionPath: Close workout -> Discard -> confirm -> render-time plan/ledger revisions -> carrier write -> ledger delete -> navigation
rootCauses: The UI submitted plan and ledger revisions captured before the confirmation interaction, so a legitimate intervening persistence update could make confirmation stale.

The old application order committed the restored planned-session carrier before deleting the active ledger attempt, leaving an inconsistent restored-plan-plus-live-attempt state when ledger deletion failed.
Ledger storage exceptions could escape the boundary, leaving the busy UI unresolved.
Errors were rendered behind the open modal and were therefore not customer-visible.
The destructive action did not dismiss an open numeric keyboard before confirmation.
correctedTransition: resolve current carrier and ledger revisions at confirmation
validate immutable snapshot identity and active-only status
delete only the mutable active ledger attempt
atomically restore the immutable planned session and remove only its active reference
restore the exact ledger aggregate if carrier CAS fails
remove attempt-owned evidence and rest timer
close modal and restore tab navigation

failureSemantics.storage: retryable; carrier and attempt remain coherent; visible customer-safe error
failureSemantics.staleRevision: rejected; no deletion or plan mutation

nativeAssertion: A started attempt containing performed work was paused, restored, cancelled once at confirmation, then discarded while the numeric keyboard owned focus. The planned immutable session returned, its active ledger attempt was absent, the keyboard closed, and a fresh attempt started and completed.
